source: Existing OS crash report copied read-only from systemCrashLogs; app was not launched and no device test was run
interpretation: An Objective-C exception during legacy player startup aborts the app. The report does not include the exception reason, so the exact invalid graph condition is not asserted.
fix: Validate player attachment/output connection, restart an engine stopped during asynchronous preparation, call the throwing playAudio() API on iOS 27+, detach failed sources and report errors through the existing UI.
